as_told.title: NASA Saturn program as a transplant of the Nazi space program

plain: NASA's Saturn rocket program, the rockets behind the Moon landings, was in this telling a "transplant" of the Nazi space program, built by the German rocket engineer Wernher von Braun, a fellow German engineer named Arthur Rudolph, and 129 Nazi scientists. Michels brings this up himself in three episodes, without naming a source. In one he stresses that it was "literally" the whole program and ties it to Apollo. In another he calls the idea a "conspiracy" and leaves out the figure of 129. He raises it because, if true, it would mean America's greatest space achievement grew straight out of the Nazi rocket effort.
